why_now.industry_shift: Tech companies prioritize conversion-centered UX design and scalable component systems over superficial visual decoration.
why_now.ai_impact: AI prototyping tools generate baseline wireframes and synthesize user research data, allowing designers to focus on information architecture and user psychology.
why_now.business_demand: High demand for specialized design skills in digital-first companies.
why_now.career_opportunity: Remote and freelance opportunities continue to grow for skilled designers.

faq.question: Do I need prior experience in UI/UX Design Professional?
faq.answer: No, this course covers fundamentals to advanced techniques.

faq.question: Are software licenses included?
faq.answer: You will need to procure your own educational or student licenses.

faq.question: Can I use these projects in my portfolio?
faq.answer: Yes, all projects are designed to be portfolio-ready.
